text:
Mercedes-Benz Stadium hyɛɛ ase wɔ May 19, 2014, na ɛbuee August 26, 2017 wɔ Atlanta mfinimfini, de sii Georgia Dome ananmu. Wɔde sika bɛyɛ US$1.6 billion (2016 nkontabuo) na wɔkyekyeree, na wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɛnnɛ yi mprempren fie ma kurow no mu ɔman bɔɔl. Georgia World Congress Center Authority na ɛwɔ, na AMB Sports and Entertainment Group na ɛhwɛ so wɔ Arthur Blank ase.

360 Architecture, HOK adwumakuw bi, na ɛdi anim, na tvsdesign, Goode Van Slyke Architecture ne Stanley Beaman & Sears na wɔka ho. Ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛda adi paa ne nsɛso a wɔatwa mu a ɛwɔ "pinwheel" triangular a ɛyɛ eight a wɔatwa mu sɛ kamera aperture a ɛbue na ɛto mu wɔ bowl no so. Ɛhɔ no FieldTurf CORE artificial turf na ɛyɛ ɛhɔ daa bɔɔlbɔbea.

Ɛfiri 2017, Mercedes-Benz Stadium ayɛ NFL Atlanta Falcons ne MLS Atlanta United FC fie, na Atlanta NWSL kuw bi bɛhyɛ ase bɔ wɔ 2028. Ɛfiri mfiase no, wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ ɛbɛma Amerika bɔɔl mu nneɛma akɛseɛ. Ɛtoo Super Bowl LIII wɔ February 3, 2019, Patriots dii Rams 13-3, na ɛtoo 2018 ne 2025 College Football Playoff National Championships. Wɔrehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛto Super Bowl LXII wɔ 2028.

Beaeɛ no nso wɔ bɔɔl abakɔsɛm papa, ɛtoo 2018 MLS Cup ne 2024 Copa America akansie mmienu. 2026 World Cup no, ɛbɛyɛ Atlanta Stadium na ɛbɛma akansie awotwe: group-stage akansie anum, Round of 32 baako, Round of 16 baako, ne semi-final wɔ July 15, 2026 — ne tournament adwuma a ɛso paa.
